items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: We move out of the clowning, you know. Oh, we had a good band here. Who's, who's on bass there? Is that Frank Fields?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, he played trumpet too.

And that's Frank Fields, I think he's bass with stuff. Bass, yeah. Yeah, and that's me there, Alto, that's Earl Palmer. Earl Palmer, one of the greatest. He's playing, well, I think he's playing with a white band in California. Studio band. That's Ernest Malin, that's a genius, Ernest Mac Lane, that's a genius.
Earl Palmer said for him to come to the studio band the other day, but his mother died, looked like he had to come back. Yeah.
